comment.text: Tooltip text indicating a scheduled change in user count, where {{fromCount}} represents the current number of users and {{toCount}} is the new amount.

usage.context:
<>
 {isCancellation || usersAdjusting ? (
 <Text fontWeight={600} fontSize="12px">
 {isCancellation
 ? t("SubscriptionCancellation")
 : t("UserAdjustment", {
 fromCount: docsConnectState?.tariffUsers ?? 0,
 toCount: scheduledUsers,
 })}
 </Text>
 ) : null}
